claim: The cumulative results demonstrate that neural crest cells migrate anteriorly to form the mesenchymal nasal cavity.
source_text: The cumulative results demonstrate that neural crest cells migrate anteriorly to form the mesenchymal nasal cavity.
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated through live imaging and fate mapping experiments.

claim: A subset of neural crest cells in the nasal cavity expresses Ngn1 and upregulates Sox10 to high levels during ingression into the olfactory epithelium to form microvillous neurons.
source_text: A subset of these cells expresses Ngn1 and upregulates Sox10 to high levels during ingression into the olfactory epithelium to form microvillous neurons.
evidence_reasoning: This is observed through live imaging of double transgenic embryos and immunohistochemistry.

claim: Laser ablation data confirm that the neural crest contribution is necessary for microvillous neurogenesis.
source_text: Laser ablation data confirm that the neural crest contribution is necessary for microvillous neurogenesis and that the olfactory placode is unable to compensate for the loss of this precursor population.
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated through laser ablation experiments showing persistent loss of microvillous neurons.

claim: High levels of the transcription factor Sox10 are necessary for microvillous neurogenesis to proceed.
source_text: Our loss-of-function studies suggest that high levels of the transcription factor Sox10 are necessary for microvillous neurogenesis to proceed.
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from morpholino knockdown experiments showing dose-dependent effects on microvillous neuron formation.
